title: Where You Go
description: Where do we look when we are tired and far from home?
This week we open Ruth 1 and ask what the passage is really saying, before we ask what it means for us.
We notice how the passage fits into the larger story of Ruth, and what has come just before it.
Along the way we meet some familiar excuses, and some better reasons to hope.
We finish with a few simple questions to take home and talk over with a friend this week.
